items.title: Santarém (PA) Health & medical procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 10 #006/2025
items.en_title: Santarém (PA) Health & medical procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 10 #006/2025
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Santarém (PA) is procuring healthcare goods or services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 21,329.16; proposals close Dec 10, 14:30 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
